entities.title: The pilot record
entities.summary: LodeStar's own text format for a saved pilot: a header with the version, one key line per field, and a CRC-32 check.
consumers: lodestar-infrastructure's PilotFiles, which stores the text as <NAME>.pilot files
Records already saved on players' machines
guarantees: The first line is LODESTAR PILOT and the version
One `key value…` line per field of RULES A.7.1; unknown keys are ignored
The check is a CRC-32 of the canonical text rebuilt from the decoded values
A record with another version, a malformed, out-of-range or repeated field, or a missing or wrong check is rejected and changes nothing
entities.compatibility: A change to the fields or their encoding needs a new VERSION; records of another version are rejected as if absent.

entities.title: PilotStore
entities.summary: The trait through which the saving feature reads and writes records; infrastructure implements it.
guarantees: read(name) returns the record stored under name, if any
write(name, record) replaces any record under name
entities.compatibility: Changing the trait changes every implementation; write has no way to report a failure (see the backlog).
